# 网络分析

基于微生物组数据构建共现网络（Co-occurrence network）。

## 载入包

```{r}
#| label: network-load-packages
library(tidyverse)
library(microeco)
library(igraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)
source("figure-notes.R")
```

## 读取 microtable 对象

```{r}
#| label: network-create-microtable
otu_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/otu_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
sample_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/sample_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) |>
    mutate(
        group = factor(group, levels = c("A", "B", "C")),
        breed = factor(breed, levels = c("Duroc", "Landrace", "Yorkshire")),
        genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("AA", "GA", "GG"))
    )
taxon_table <- read.csv("data/amplicon-sequencing/taxon_table_mt.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

# 剔除 NA 分类
keep_taxa <- !is.na(taxon_table$Genus) & taxon_table$Genus != "" &
    !taxon_table$Genus %in% c("g__", "Unclassified")
has_valid_taxa <- any(keep_taxa)
taxon_table <- taxon_table[keep_taxa, ]
otu_table <- otu_table[rownames(taxon_table), ]

if (has_valid_taxa) {
    mt <- microtable$new(otu_table = otu_table, sample_table = sample_table, tax_table = taxon_table)
    mt$tidy_dataset()
} else {
    cat("当前分类表没有有效属水平注释（SILVA 数据库缺失时会标记为 Unclassified）。网络分析已跳过；提供 SILVA_DB_FILE 并重新运行 DADA2 注释后可启用本章分析。\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: network-plot-helper
add_taxonomy_attrs <- function(network_obj, dataset) {
    graph <- network_obj$res_network
    tax_table <- dataset$tax_table |> as.data.frame()
    vertex_names <- igraph::V(graph)$name
    matched_taxa <- tax_table[match(vertex_names, rownames(tax_table)), , drop = FALSE]
    genus <- if ("Genus" %in% names(matched_taxa)) matched_taxa$Genus else vertex_names

    igraph::V(graph)$Genus <- ifelse(
        is.na(genus) | genus == "",
        vertex_names,
        stringr::str_remove(genus, "^g__")
    )
    igraph::V(graph)$label_name <- ifelse(
        igraph::V(graph)$Genus == vertex_names,
        vertex_names,
        paste0(igraph::V(graph)$Genus, "\n", vertex_names)
    )
    igraph::V(graph)$degree <- igraph::degree(graph)
    graph
}

plot_network_ggraph <- function(network_obj, dataset, color_by = "module", label_top = 10) {
    graph <- add_taxonomy_attrs(network_obj, dataset)
    label_cutoff <- stats::quantile(igraph::V(graph)$degree, probs = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)

    tidygraph::as_tbl_graph(graph) |>
        ggraph::ggraph(layout = "fr") +
        ggraph::geom_edge_link(
            aes(width = abs(weight), alpha = abs(weight)),
            colour = "grey65",
            show.legend = FALSE
        ) +
        ggraph::geom_node_point(
            aes(color = .data[[color_by]], size = RelativeAbundance),
            alpha = 0.9
        ) +
        ggraph::geom_node_text(
            aes(label = ifelse(degree >= label_cutoff, Genus, "")),
            repel = TRUE,
            size = 2.6,
            max.overlaps = label_top,
            show.legend = FALSE
        ) +
        scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 1.2)) +
        scale_edge_alpha(range = c(0.15, 0.55)) +
        scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.8, 7), name = "Relative abundance") +
        labs(color = stringr::str_to_title(color_by)) +
        theme_void() +
        theme(
            legend.position = "right",
            plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
        )
}
```

## 按基因型拆分子集

```{r}
#| label: split-by-genotype
make_subset <- function(mt, genotype_name) {
    sample_sub <- mt$sample_table[mt$sample_table$genotype == genotype_name, , drop = FALSE]
    otu_sub <- mt$otu_table[, rownames(sample_sub), drop = FALSE]
    tax_sub <- mt$tax_table[rownames(otu_sub), ]
    m <- microtable$new(otu_table = otu_sub, tax_table = tax_sub, sample_table = sample_sub)
    m$tidy_dataset()
    return(m)
}

mt_AA <- make_subset(mt, "AA")
mt_GA <- make_subset(mt, "GA")
mt_GG <- make_subset(mt, "GG")

cat("Genotype AA:", ncol(mt_AA$otu_table), "samples,", nrow(mt_AA$otu_table), "taxa\n")
cat("Genotype GA:", ncol(mt_GA$otu_table), "samples,", nrow(mt_GA$otu_table), "taxa\n")
cat("Genotype GG:", ncol(mt_GG$otu_table), "samples,", nrow(mt_GG$otu_table), "taxa\n")
```

## 共现网络构建

使用 SparCC 方法计算相关性。

```{r}
#| label: build-network
#| warning: false
# SparCC method
t1 <- trans_network$new(
    dataset = mt,
    cor_method = "spearman",
    filter_thres = 0.001
)
t1$cal_network(COR_p_thru = 0.05, COR_cut = 0.4)
t1$cal_module()
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-plot-network
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "全部样本的共现网络，按属水平着色。"
plot_network_ggraph(t1, mt, color_by = "Genus")
```


```{r}
#| label: note-plot-network
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
render_figure_note("plot-network")
```

### 网络属性

```{r}
#| label: network-attr
res_network = t1$cal_network_attr()
res_network
```

### Hub 节点

```{r}
#| label: hub-nodes
node_table <- t1$res_node_table
hub <- node_table[node_table$degree > quantile(node_table$degree, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE), ]
hub[, c("Genus", "Abundance", "degree", "betweenness", "closeness")]
```

## 网络属性比较

```{r}
#| label: network-comparison
get_network_metric = function(network_obj, metric) {
    network_obj$cal_network_attr()
    attr_table = network_obj$res_network_attr
    as.numeric(attr_table[metric, 1])
}

network_attrs <- data.frame(
    Genotype = c("All", "AA", "GA", "GG"),
    Nodes = c(get_network_metric(t1, "Vertex"), get_network_metric(tAA, "Vertex"),
              get_network_metric(tGA, "Vertex"), get_network_metric(tGG, "Vertex")),
    Edges = c(get_network_metric(t1, "Edge"), get_network_metric(tAA, "Edge"),
              get_network_metric(tGA, "Edge"), get_network_metric(tGG, "Edge")),
    Modularity = c(get_network_metric(t1, "Modularity"), get_network_metric(tAA, "Modularity"),
                   get_network_metric(tGA, "Modularity"), get_network_metric(tGG, "Modularity"))
)
network_attrs
```
